description: This file defines a component called 'DestinationList' using a component framework (possibly Lightning.js), which displays a list of destination items with scrolling functionality. It manages state related to layout, scrolling, and rendering destination cards based on provided items prop.

classes.name: DestinationList
classes.description: A UI component that lists destinations with scrolling and visual indicators.

methods.name: calcX
methods.description: Calculates the X position for a destination card based on its index.

methods.name: calcY
methods.description: Calculates the Y position for a destination card based on its index.

methods.name: updateThumb
methods.description: Updates scrollbar thumb size and position based on current scroll offset.

methods.name: $onSelect
methods.description: Handles the event when a destination is selected, logs the selected item's title.
